Figure 6: Attention contribution flow across loops in a high-entropy head (Layer 2, Head 15). Each cell shows the weighted attention contribution Cj = AN,j · ∥Vj∥2 from the final token to position j, with color intensity indicating magnitude. Red and blue borders mark tokens with the largest contribution increase and decrease from Loop 0 to Loop 2, respectively. Arrows with percentage labels denote inter-loop changes. The visualization shows attention progressively shifting from syntactic elements toward task-critical and answer-relevant tokens.
